_comment: Illustrative normalized change event for testing /ci-stack:ci-triage. Fictional competitor. Field names and types follow Visualping's documented webhook payload as of 2026-08-06, but this is NOT a verbatim vendor contract — verify against current docs before writing an integration. Note that a real payload also contains autologin and tokenised diff URLs; those are deliberately omitted here because they must never be written into a brief.
summarizer: The Team plan price increased and a new usage limit was introduced. An enterprise-only SSO note was removed from the plan comparison.
added_text: Team — $49 per user / month billed annually. Includes 5,000 automation runs per month. Additional runs billed at $0.002 each. SAML SSO available on all paid plans.
removed_text: Team — $39 per user / month billed annually. Unlimited automation runs. SAML SSO available on Enterprise only.
